summary: All 8 cases are Src:Code backend concurrency guards. A black-box tester can reach almost none: 1 BLOCKED on a safe test NPO (harness proven ready), 7 NOT EXECUTED (backend-only, feature-absent, or needing owned records in specific states + permission to fire concurrent mutations on shared QA). No new coverage; one real defect surfaced building the harness.

TC-14X-003_link-race.verdict: BLOCKED — harness ready, no safe linkable test NPO

harnessProven.linkModal: boxfusion.dsdnpo/dsd-link-existing-npo v13 — NPO Number field + search
harnessProven.lookupRequiresAuth: 401 anonymous — this SERVICE endpoint enforces auth, unlike the dynamic CRUD layer (sharpens the Class B finding: the anonymous-read gap is the /api/dynamic/ CRUD layer specifically)

TC-14X-003_link-race.whyBlocked: Linking claims Authorised Admin over a real NPO. Accounts A/B are office bearers of no NPO, and there is no designated test NPO both may legitimately link. Firing A+B link-confirm at a real org would hijack it — not done. Needs a test NPO from Thabiso.

defectFoundBuildingHarness.finding: GetNPOByNpoNumber returns HTTP 500 for 7 of 12 sampled real NPOs — orphaned Shesha.Domain.Person reference unhandled; a non-existent number also 500s ('Npo Not Found') though the UI catches that one.
defectFoundBuildingHarness.uiHandlingOfNotFound: friendly 'NPO Number Not Found!' shown for the not-found path

perCaseVerdicts.TC-14X-001_two-admin-doc-verification: NOT EXECUTED — needs an owned application at a document-verification decision point + two admin identities; a double state-transition on a real application is unsafe on shared QA. Not simulated.
perCaseVerdicts.TC-14X-002_submitter-resubmit-vs-admin: NOT EXECUTED — needs a submitter-owned application in a decidable state paired with an admin on the same application; not safely constructable this pass.
perCaseVerdicts.TC-14X-004_PersonIdVerifier-lock: NOT EXECUTED — internal lock (PersonIdVerifier.cs:48-49), no UI trigger alignable to the millisecond; 'no double DHA call' only visible in logs/integration we lack.
perCaseVerdicts.TC-14X-005_two-admin-investigator-assign: NOT EXECUTED — needs an investigation case in an assignable state + two admins.
perCaseVerdicts.TC-14X-006_OB-confirmation-race: NOT EXECUTED — needs a pending OB confirmation link + an admin editing the same application.
perCaseVerdicts.TC-14X-007_bulk-reallocation-upload: NOT EXECUTED — no reallocation upload screen exists (form registry: 0 of 8294 match reallocat*; only add-content-file and form-import-json are upload forms).
perCaseVerdicts.TC-14X-008_backgroundjob-vs-transaction: NOT EXECUTED — background-job-vs-transaction timing (ApplicationManager.cs:278-283 cache-bypass); no client-alignable trigger.
